how_to_apply: Download the application form and checklist provided with the advertisement on pages 3 to 5.

Attach self-attested copies of all testimonials, passport size photographs, and required certificates in the specified order.
Bring the filled application form along with original documents.
Attend the walk-in interview at Seminar Hall (Ground Floor), Doctor's Hostel, DDUH, Hari Nagar, New Delhi-64 on 13.10.2026 between 9:30 AM and 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q1. What is DDUH Junior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in interview recruitment process conducted by Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital for filling up 9 Junior Resident posts on an adhoc basis for 89 days.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DDUH Junior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 tentative vacancies available for the Junior Resident post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 13.10.2026 and 14.10.2026 (reserve day), with reporting time from 9:30 AM to 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Seminar Hall (Ground Floor), Doctor's Hostel, DDUH, Hari Nagar, New Delhi-64.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from an NMC recognized university/institute or an equivalent degree, with a cleared FMG examination for foreign graduates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for general candidates?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for general candidates is 30 years as on the date of interview, with relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the pay scale for DDUH Junior Resident?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a pay scale at Level-10 (Rs. 56,100-1,77,500) plus usual allowances.

faq.question: Q8. Is DMC registration mandatory?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must have a valid DMC certificate at the time of interview; DMC acknowledgement will not be accepted.
